## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasPasswordRuleLegend> CreatePasswordRuleLegend( const std::string& id, float x, float y, float w, float h, LegendStyle style = LegendStyle::Checklist);
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasPasswordRuleLegend> CreateChecklistLegend( const std::string& id, float x, float y, float w, float h);
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasPasswordRuleLegend(const std::string& id, float x, float y, float w, float h);
UltraCanvasPasswordRuleLegend(const std::string& id, float w, float h);
explicit UltraCanvasPasswordRuleLegend(const std::string& id);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).
